version_policy: HttpEntity mutability is established only for checked 5.3, 6.2 and 7.0 families. Other/unspecified versions retain alternatives. Per-module explicit Spring dependencies or context framework_versions may establish this contract. Bounded Boot parent/configuration/profile support is recorded separately under spring_configuration; complete Maven/Gradle dependency resolution is absent.
implementation: Our bounded semantic contracts, not an executing Spring library. Readonly list views stop with unsupported diagnostics.

checked_rules: Default jQuery verb GET and contentType form-urlencoded
Object data processed independently of declared contentType
Source headers are case insensitive; explicit header overrides contentType default

browser_http.boundary: Bounded jQuery/AngularJS/Spring contracts. Compound requests, hooks, full DOM and cookie/CORS lifecycle remain unsupported. Selected Python form/Bearer and body/response contracts now use pinned native libraries; see native_python.

native_python.policy: Execute only allowlisted pinned library primitives. Source functions use IR. Conflicting supplied versions stop unsupported; unspecified versions assume this pinned contract. No target import or startup execution.

spring_configuration.scope: Deployment-scoped conventional classpath sources, bounded literal profile selectors and ordered resolved Environment snapshots. External config fetch, custom imports, locations, ConfigData loader and full bootstrap lifecycle are unsupported.

spring_MVC_validation.scope: Bounded field Default-group constraints, selected source exception handlers and known routing status. Custom getter/class/field validation, groups, selectors, resolvers and full request/response lifecycle are not inferred.

java_time.scope: Selected LocalDate/LocalDateTime/ZoneId/Instant/Date conversions over explicit scenario time and pinned timezone data. No wall clock or OS timezone files. Regional rules require matching timezone_database. Nanoseconds, extended years and unspecified codecs are explicit cutoffs.

java_streams_and_wrappers.scope: Bounded sequential reference streams, source/static/bound/unbound/constructor method references, lazy native iterator traversal, selected terminal operations, native scalar boxing, source set hash/equals callbacks and small collision buckets. Parallelism, unordered multi-element traversal, count callback elision, large collision trees, unknown source interference and unsupported overloads are diagnostic boundaries. This is not a JVM or full JDK implementation. Float/Double/Character wrappers, arbitrary generic bridges and codecs remain unsupported.
